itemListElement.name: Read AI Alternatives US Teams Are Switching To in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best Read AI alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best Read AI alternative for most teams is the one that matches their follow-up work. Lynkk suits teams that want tasks and Jira tickets, Fireflies suits CRM-driven sales teams, and Fathom suits anyone who wants free unlimited recording.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free alternative to Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom offers unlimited free recordings and transcripts. Otter, Jamie and Lynkk also have free plans, with limits of 300 minutes, 10 notes and 5 notes a month respectively. Read AI's own free plan stops at 5 meetings a month, so even the smallest free plans above are comparable for light use.

mainEntity.name: What is the Microsoft alternative to Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Microsoft's alternative is the AI recap in Teams, which comes with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. It works well inside Teams but does not cover Zoom, Google Meet or in-person meetings. If your company does not license Copilot, a third-party tool that joins Teams calls is usually the more affordable route.

mainEntity.name: Who are Read AI's main competitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI's main competitors are Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Granola, tl;dv, Jamie and Lynkk. Each takes a different approach, from live transcription to bot-free notes to automated follow-up. Compare them on free limits, price per user, privacy controls and what happens after the meeting.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a Read AI alternative without a meeting bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Granola and Jamie are bot-free by design. Lynkk gives you both options: a bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams, or bot-free recording through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Bot-free capture still records, so announce it at the start of each call, especially with clients.

mainEntity.name: Does any Read AI alternative support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk supports Hindi and has a Hinglish setting for conversations that mix Hindi and English. Read AI lists 20+ languages, so check its list against the languages your team uses.
